title: Ask
intro: Ask a question about the ingested documents. The answer names its sources; without evidence in the documents there is no answer.

form.label: Ask a question
form.question: Question
form.hint: Ctrl+Enter sends the question; Enter starts a new line.
form.tooLong: At most {{max}} characters – please shorten the question.

unavailable.off: The AI features are switched off, so there are no answers. The search still finds the places in the documents.
unavailable.notAvailable: Answers are not available at the moment. The search still finds the places in the documents.

answer.label: Answer
answer.cancelled: Cancelled – this text was not checked.

noEvidence.text: I can't find anything on this in the documents.
noEvidence.search: Search the documents for this question

contradiction.text: The documents contradict each other. Compare the marked places.

error.interrupted: The connection broke off before the answer was complete. Please ask again.
error.inProgress: Another answer of yours is still running. Please wait until it is complete.
error.tooMany: Too many questions in a short time. Please wait a moment and ask again.

stream.model_unavailable: The language model cannot be reached.
stream.model_rejected: The language model refused the request.
stream.internal: The answer failed because of an internal error.
